news.title: MBARC Kickoff Meeting
news.summary: Initial project meeting to discuss goals and objectives.
content: The M-BARC project (Microlaser Acoustic Sensors for Mechanical Barcoding of Cells and Particles) has officially launched with its online kickoff meeting

Funded by Horizon Europe and coordinated by Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam, M-BARC brings together seven partners from six countries. Over 42 months, the consortium will develop a label-free platform that uses microring lasers to read the mechanical “barcode” of cells, with applications in IVF, antibiotic resistance and drug screening.
We look forward to turning this ambitious vision into reality. Stay tuned!
